description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The State of Missouri is hiring an ITSD Applications Developer to support the Department of Revenue’s Integrated Tax System. The role focuses on application and database development, data processing and analysis, and maintaining documentation.
Application Developer updating e-file processing rules and rejects with C#, plus SSIS integrations and SQL procedures

Responsibilities:
• Data Tracking & Analysis: Use data logs to hunt down processing anomalies and ensure inbound files load smoothly into the system
• Database & Integration Work: Create, run, and optimize SSIS packages, and develop data fixes or stored procedures using Microsoft SQL
• Business Logic & Development: Modify and create rules using a dedicated rules engine and utilize C# to update rejects for the Modernized e-File system
• Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain clean, reliable documentation to help the team scale and succeed

Requirements:
• Authorization to work in the United States
• Experience in application development utilizing Microsoft technologies
• Experience with MS SQL Server development
• Proficiency and hands-on experience working within the Visual Studio environment
• Knowledge of the supported business area
• Ability to understand client's needs and technical requirements and implement solutions
• Ability to identify and resolve programming issues
• Ability to respond to changing priorities
• Ability to collaborate with other professionals

Preferred:
• AWS Cloud Solutions and TIDAL
• XML and Notepad++
• A genuine desire to continually develop new skills through self-study, assigned training, or attending user group presentations
• You thrive when juggling multiple priorities and can react quickly to shifting, fast-paced situations
• Experience using C# and business rule development
• Experience working with interfaces and SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services)
